how_its_made:
Melon Allows people to easily stake ETH/USDC or AAVE.

Users can deposit assets in the following chains:
- Morph
- Arbitrum

Yet, Morph and Avail are in Tesnet phase. We have no markets there.
Arbitrum and Gnosis have AAVE Market where we can even use Beefy strategies to optimize Yield.
